verses.text: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

segments.text: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD?

verses.text: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

segments.text: pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

notes: 10.2 The wicked…: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute

verses.text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

segments.text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous,

notes: 10.3 blesseth…: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD

verses.text: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

segments.text: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek

notes: 10.4 God is…: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God

verses.text: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

segments.text: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments
far above out of his sight:
all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.text: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

segments.text: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for

notes: 10.6 never: Heb. unto generation and generation

verses.text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

segments.text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue

verses.text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

segments.text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

verses.text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

segments.text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

notes: 10.9 secretly: Heb. in the secret places

verses.text: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

segments.text: humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

notes: 10.10 by…: or, into his strong parts

verses.text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

segments.text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see

verses.text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

segments.text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

verses.text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

segments.text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require

verses.text: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

segments.text: for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite
with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

verses.text: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

segments.text: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil

verses.text: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

segments.text: King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

segments.text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

verses.text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

segments.text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
